summary: Armour Residential REIT filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register up to 25,544,352 shares of common stock for an at-the-market offering under an existing equity distribution agreement. The filing amends a prior supplement and increases the available shares by 25,000,000 (post-reverse split). No specific price, premium, or definitive terms are stated; sales will be made through agents including BUCKLER, B. Riley, Citizens JMP, and others at commissions up to 2.0%. This is a routine shelf takedown and not a special situation. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No deal, activism, or restructuring is present.
